description: Exact options (type, required, default, choices, aliases, suboptions) of a module or plugin as INSTALLED here (ansible-doc), with the collection version that provides it and redirects resolved. Use before writing a task; options drift between collection versions, so training-data guesses are often wrong.

description_chars.description: Truncate each description to this many characters; 0 = no limit (default 160)

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

name.description: FQCN or short name, e.g. community.general.ufw or ufw

type.description: module | lookup | filter | test | callback | connection | inventory | become | cache | vars | strategy | shell | cliconf | httpapi | netconf | keyword

name: ansible_module_doc
title: Installed module/plugin spec
